name: Saint of the Last Furnace
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Saint of the Last Furnace. Towering living brass forge idol crowned with crucible ladles, hanging repair-chain halo behind head, enormous open glowing chest furnace, massive soot-black articulated hands, broad buttress-like feet. Crown comprises curved long handled foundry ladles with bowl-shaped tops; asymmetrical hanging heavy chains, no religious logos, no human rider. Idle: 1 both huge hands hang open beside hips; 2 left elbow bends raising palm to chest furnace and right fingers curl; 3 left palm turns outward at shoulder height, right fist lifts to waist; 4 both elbows relax halfway and hands reopen. Large visible changes of elbow/wrist/fingers, tiny chest breathing only secondary. Entire halo, ladle crown, feet, fingers within each cell.
reference_use: Original generation based on approved unit upgrade design brief.
